hook.name: BasedBidHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that layers configurable trading fees (static, tiered, or dynamic with surge pricing) onto every swap, distributing collected fees to liquidity providers via donation, buyback-and-burn of the project token, reward distributors, or custom wallets. Also includes OpenZeppelin anti-sandwich protection, Merkle-proof whitelist buy-limits during a launch window, volume-based fee multipliers, and cooldown penalties for rapid trading.
